# The Resident Bookkeeper

The Resident Bookkeeper is a bookkeeping company based in Nigeria and serving businesses remotely across Nigeria, the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada.

Tagline: Accurate Records • Smarter Decisions • Stronger Business.

## Core services
- Full-cycle bookkeeping
- Bank reconciliations
- Accounts payable and accounts receivable support
- Catch-up bookkeeping
- Cleanup bookkeeping
- Financial reporting
- Ongoing bookkeeping support

## Pricing
Starter: $250/month
Growth: $450/month
Business: $750/month
Catch-up: from $300
Cleanup: from $250
Custom/Complex: from $1,000/month

Final pricing depends on transaction volume, number of accounts, software, reporting requirements and the condition of the books.
